label: copy phase: input p while outputting p (copying a doubled "pp" in the original)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the input token is p (100% of mass), always on a p that has already been seen. 89% of mass is on steps where the output is also p, i.e. the model is reproducing a doubled pp from the original sequence and has just fed back the first p. The strongest activations are pp at original positions 2-3 (recall_idx 3); magnitude is highest around recall_idx 3-4, lower at recall_idx 2 and 5+, and near zero at recall_idx 0-1. In ppp runs the second fed-back p fires more weakly. Weak tail: input p followed by another output (s, f, a, ...), usually at low activation. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any other input token. Imprecise: many p->p copy steps stay silent, especially pp near the start (orig positions 0-1) or late in long sequences.
